token.label: API Token
token.description: Your Village API token. Generate one from your Village settings and paste it here.

get_app_info.label: Get App Information
get_app_info.description: Get information about the partner application associated with your token — title, description, domain, logo URL, public key, and active flag. Useful for verifying your app configuration.

check_company_paths.label: Check Company Paths
check_company_paths.description: Quickly check if you have connections to a company without fetching full details. Returns whether paths exist, an overall score, count of reachable people, and avatar thumbnails.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "acme.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

check_company_paths.beforeRequest: const given = ["domain", "linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); return request;

companies_refresh.label: Refresh Companies
companies_refresh.description: Refresh/import company data from LinkedIn URLs or domains. Realtime mode returns enriched data synchronously (or times out after 25s); async mode returns job IDs for later status checking. At least one of linkedin_urls or domains must be provided.

job_ids.label: Job IDs
job_ids.description: Job IDs to check status for (returned by async refresh calls). A JSON array.

linkedin_urls.label: LinkedIn URLs
linkedin_urls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs to refresh. A JSON array.

domains.label: Domains
domains.description: Company domains to refresh, e.g. "example.com". A JSON array.

realtime.label: Realtime
realtime.description: If true, wait for enrichment (up to ~25s) and return company data inline. If false, return job IDs immediately.

companies_refresh.beforeRequest: const body = { realtime: request.body.realtime }; for (const key of ['linkedin_urls', 'domains', 'job_ids']) { const values = Array.isArray(request.body[key]) ? request.body[key].map(String) : []; if (values.length > 0) body[key] = values; } if (!body.linkedin_urls && !body.domains && !body.job_ids) throw new Error('At least one of linkedin_urls, domains, or job_ids must be provided'); request.body = body; return request;

enrich_company.label: Enrich Company
enrich_company.description: Get detailed information about a company by domain, LinkedIn URL, or any URL. Returns name, website, LinkedIn URL, logo, employee count, industry, founded year, and description.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "example.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

enrich_company.beforeRequest: const given = ["domain", "linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); return request;

enrich_company_bulk.label: Enrich Company (Bulk)
enrich_company_bulk.description: Get detailed information for up to 10 companies in a single request. Each result contains either company data or an error.

identifiers.label: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Up to 10 companies to look up. Each row specifies an identifier type and value. Each item is {"identifierType": "domain", "linkedin_url" or "url", "identifierValue": "..."}.

enrich_company_bulk.beforeRequest: const identifiers = request.body.identifiers ?? []; if (identifiers.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one identifier is required'); if (identifiers.length > 10) throw new Error('Maximum 10 identifiers per bulk request'); request.body.identifiers = identifiers.map((item, index) => { if (!item.identifierType || !item.identifierValue) throw new Error('Identifier at index ' + index + ' is missing identifierType or identifierValue'); return { [item.identifierType]: item.identifierValue }; }); return request;

get_company_paths.label: Get Company Paths
get_company_paths.description: Find introduction paths to people at a specific company. Returns up to 50 employees you can reach through your network, ranked by connection strength.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "acme.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 50)

connection_degrees.label: Connection Degrees
connection_degrees.description: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values. A JSON array.

get_company_paths.beforeRequest: const given = ["domain", "linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: domain, linkedin_url, url'); if (Array.isArray(request.body.connection_degrees)) request.body.connection_degrees = request.body.connection_degrees.map(Number); return request;

list_companies.label: List Companies
list_companies.description: Get your top-connected companies ranked by network strength. Returns a paginated list with connection score, label, LinkedIn URL, domain, and enrichment data.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)

connection_degrees.label: Connection Degrees
connection_degrees.description: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values. A JSON array.

search_companies.label: Search Companies
search_companies.description: Search for companies using natural language (in the "prompt" field) and/or structured filters. Returns matching companies with relevance and connection-strength scores; supports cursor-based pagination.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural language search query, e.g. "Find B2B SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in California". Either prompt or filters must be provided.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Structured filters. Supported keys: name, domain, linkedinUrl, linkedinId, industry, companySize, companyType, country, city, foundedAfter, foundedBefore, keywords.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (default 25, max 100)

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Search mode: auto (let system decide), lookup (direct match), simple (LLM-powered), or complex (thinking + high-reasoning SQL generation).

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Search scope: network (connections first) or global (all companies).

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor (encoded string) from a previous response.

include_counts.label: Include Counts
include_counts.description: Inline count scope to compute on the first page only. Ignored when cursor is provided and adds latency.

search_companies.beforeRequest: if (!request.body.prompt && !request.body.filters) throw new Error('Either prompt or filters must be provided.'); return request;

sort_companies.label: Sort Companies
sort_companies.description: Rank a list of companies (up to 100 LinkedIn URLs or domains) by how well-connected you are to people there. Each result includes a score, label, LinkedIn URL, and domain.

companies.label: Companies
companies.description: Array of company URLs (LinkedIn URLs or domains), e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" or "example.com". Max 100. A JSON array.

sort_companies.beforeRequest: const companies = request.body.companies; if (!Array.isArray(companies) || companies.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one company URL is required'); if (companies.length > 100) throw new Error('Maximum 100 companies per request'); request.body.companies = companies.map(String); return request;

join_group.label: Join Group
join_group.description: Join a group using an invite link. Once joined, you gain access to the shared network of all group members.

group_invite_link.label: Group Invite Link
group_invite_link.description: The invite link code shared by a group admin or member

leave_group.label: Leave Group
leave_group.description: Leave a group you are a member of. If you are the last member, the group is deleted. Admins must remove all other members before leaving.

group_id.label: Group ID
group_id.description: ID of the group to leave

list_groups.label: List Groups
list_groups.description: Get all groups (communities) you are a member of. Groups allow members to share network access with each other, expanding everyone's reach.

upsert_group.label: Create or Update Group
upsert_group.description: Create a new group or update an existing one. To create: provide a name (id is auto-generated). To update: provide group_id (requires admin permissions).

group_id.label: Group ID
group_id.description: Existing group ID to update. Omit to create a new group.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: URL to the group logo image

list_integrations.label: List Integrations
list_integrations.description: Get all your connected Gmail integrations, including rate limits, timezone, the default sending account, and whether you can add more based on your plan.

resync_integration.label: Resync Integration
resync_integration.description: Trigger a full resync of a Google or LinkedIn integration. Clears sync cursors and re-imports all contacts/calendar data; all graph operations use MERGE so it is fully idempotent.

id.label: Integration ID
id.description: Numeric ID of the integration to resync

update_integration.label: Update Integration
update_integration.description: Update settings for a connected Gmail integration — adjust rate limits, timezone, status, or set as the default sending account. Provide only the fields you want to change.

id.label: Integration ID
id.description: Numeric ID of the integration to update

email_sending_min_delay_seconds.label: Minimum Delay (seconds)
email_sending_min_delay_seconds.description: Minimum delay between emails in seconds (60-3600)

email_sending_default.label: Set as Default
email_sending_default.description: Whether this should be the default integration for email sending

update_integration.beforeRequest: const ranges = { email_sending_per_day: [1, 500], email_sending_per_hour: [1, 100], email_sending_min_delay_seconds: [60, 3600] }; for (const [key, [low, high]] of Object.entries(ranges)) { const value = request.body[key]; if (value != null && (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < low || value > high)) throw new Error(key + ' must be an integer between ' + low + ' and ' + high + ' (got ' + value + ')'); } if (Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field must be provided for update (email_sending_per_day, email_sending_per_hour, email_sending_min_delay_seconds, timezone, status, or email_sending_default)'); return request;

add_list_items.label: Add List Items
add_list_items.description: Add people or companies to a list. Each identifier is resolved (LinkedIn URLs, company domains, emails, or graph IDs) and added. Returns detailed results per item.

items.label: Items
items.description: Items to add to the list (max 100). Each item is {"identifier": "...", "type": "people" or "company"}.

add_list_items.beforeRequest: const items = request.body.items ?? []; if (items.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one item is required'); if (items.length > 100) throw new Error('Maximum 100 items per request'); request.body.items = items.map((item, index) => { if (!item.identifier) throw new Error("Item at index " + index + " is missing required 'identifier'"); const entry = { identifier: item.identifier }; if (item.type) entry.type = item.type; return entry; }); return request;

check_list_membership.label: Check List Membership
check_list_membership.description: Check which lists contain the given entities. Returns a map of entity_id to the lists that contain it. Entities not in any list are omitted.

entity_ids.label: Entity IDs
entity_ids.description: Array of entity IDs (person or company IDs) to check membership for (max 1000). A JSON array.

check_list_membership.beforeRequest: const ids = request.body.entity_ids ?? []; if (ids.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one entity ID is required'); if (ids.length > 1000) throw new Error('Maximum 1000 entity IDs per request'); request.body.entity_ids = ids; return request;

create_list.label: Create List
create_list.description: Create a new list to organize people or companies. The creator becomes the list owner. List creation may be limited based on your subscription plan.

type.label: Type
type.description: Type of entities in the list

is_public.label: Is Public
is_public.description: Whether the list is publicly accessible

delete_list.label: Delete List
delete_list.description: Permanently delete a list and all its items. This action cannot be undone.

remove_list_items.label: Remove List Items
remove_list_items.description: Remove items from a list by their item IDs (from Get List). Returns the count of successfully removed items.

item_ids.label: Item IDs
item_ids.description: Array of item IDs to remove from the list (max 100). A JSON array.

remove_list_items.beforeRequest: const itemIds = request.body.item_ids ?? []; if (itemIds.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one item ID is required'); if (itemIds.length > 100) throw new Error('Maximum 100 item IDs per request'); return request;

get_list.label: Get List
get_list.description: Get a list with all its items. Returns the list metadata plus paginated items. For people lists, items are sorted by connection strength (warmth score).

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor for items pagination (from previous response)

list_lists.label: List Lists
list_lists.description: Get all your saved lists of people or companies. Supports pagination, filtering by type, and searching by title.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)

update_list.label: Update List
update_list.description: Update a list's metadata. Provide at least one of: title or description. The list type cannot be changed after creation.

description.label: Description
description.description: New list description. Leave blank to keep unchanged.

update_list.beforeRequest: if (Object.keys(request.body).length === 0) throw new Error('At least one field must be provided for update (title or description)'); return request;

enrich_person.label: Enrich Person
enrich_person.description: Get detailed profile information (name, headline, current company, location, photo, LinkedIn URL) for a person identified by LinkedIn URL or generic URL.

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)

enrich_person.beforeRequest: const given = ["linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: linkedin_url, url'); return request;

enrich_person_bulk.label: Enrich Person (Bulk)
enrich_person_bulk.description: Get detailed profile information for up to 10 people in a single request. Partial results are returned if some lookups fail — check each result for success or error status.

identifiers.label: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Up to 10 people to enrich. Each row is one person. Each item is {"identifierType": "linkedin_url" or "url", "identifierValue": "..."}.

enrich_person_bulk.beforeRequest: const identifiers = request.body.identifiers; if (!Array.isArray(identifiers) || identifiers.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one identifier is required.'); if (identifiers.length > 10) throw new Error('Maximum 10 identifiers per bulk request.'); request.body.identifiers = identifiers.map((item, index) => { if (!item?.identifierType || !item?.identifierValue) throw new Error('Identifier at index ' + index + ' is missing identifierType or identifierValue.'); return { [item.identifierType]: item.identifierValue }; }); return request;

enrich_person_email.label: Enrich Person Email
enrich_person_email.description: Find the email address for a person by LinkedIn URL or generic URL. Returns the verified email address if found, or null if unavailable.

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)

enrich_person_email.beforeRequest: const given = ["linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: linkedin_url, url'); return request;

enrich_person_email_bulk.label: Enrich Person Email (Bulk)
enrich_person_email_bulk.description: Find email addresses for up to 10 people in a single request. Returns email addresses where found, with error messages for failed lookups.

identifiers.label: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Up to 10 people to look up emails for. Each row is one person. Each item is {"identifierType": "linkedin_url" or "url", "identifierValue": "..."}.

enrich_person_email_bulk.beforeRequest: const identifiers = request.body.identifiers; if (!Array.isArray(identifiers) || identifiers.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one identifier is required.'); if (identifiers.length > 10) throw new Error('Maximum 10 identifiers per bulk request.'); request.body.identifiers = identifiers.map((item, index) => { if (!item?.identifierType || !item?.identifierValue) throw new Error('Identifier at index ' + index + ' is missing identifierType or identifierValue.'); return { [item.identifierType]: item.identifierValue }; }); return request;

get_person_paths.label: Get Person Paths
get_person_paths.description: Find introduction paths to reach a specific person through your professional network. Provide a LinkedIn URL and get back direct connections, mutual contacts, and connection strength scores (0-100).

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the target person, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)

url.label: URL
url.description: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)

get_person_paths.beforeRequest: const given = ["linkedin_url", "url"].filter(key => request.body[key] !== undefined); if (given.length === 0) throw new Error('Provide one of: linkedin_url, url'); if (given.length > 1) throw new Error('Provide only one of: linkedin_url, url'); return request;

get_person_paths_bulk.label: Get Person Paths (Bulk)
get_person_paths_bulk.description: Find introduction paths to multiple people in a single request. Provide up to 100 LinkedIn IDs (the slug after linkedin.com/in/) and get connection paths for each.

linkedin_ids.label: LinkedIn IDs
linkedin_ids.description: LinkedIn identifiers (e.g. "johndoe" from linkedin.com/in/johndoe). Max 100 per request. A JSON array.

get_person_paths_bulk.beforeRequest: const ids = request.body.linkedin_ids; if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one LinkedIn ID is required.'); if (ids.length > 100) throw new Error('Maximum 100 LinkedIn IDs per bulk request.'); return request;

list_people.label: List People
list_people.description: Get your network contacts ranked by connection strength. Returns a paginated list with enrichment data, supporting cursor-based pagination and optional connection-degree filtering.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)

connection_degrees.label: Connection Degrees
connection_degrees.description: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values. A JSON array.

company_domain.label: Company Domain
company_domain.description: Filter by current company domain (exact match), e.g. "google.com"

people_refresh.label: Refresh People
people_refresh.description: Refresh or import people data from LinkedIn URLs. In realtime mode, returns enriched person data immediately (or times out after 25 seconds and converts to async). In async mode, returns job IDs for later status checking.

linkedin_urls.label: LinkedIn URLs
linkedin_urls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs to refresh. At least one is required. A JSON array.

realtime.label: Realtime
realtime.description: If true, waits synchronously for results (up to 25s). If false, returns job IDs for async processing.

people_refresh.beforeRequest: const urls = request.body.linkedin_urls; if (!Array.isArray(urls) || urls.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one LinkedIn URL is required.'); request.body.linkedin_urls = urls.map(String); return request;

search_people.label: Search People
search_people.description: Search for people using natural language queries. Pass your search text in "prompt" (e.g. "engineers at Google"). Supports cursor-based pagination and structured filters.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural language search query (e.g. "Find CTOs at SaaS companies in San Francisco")

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Structured search filters as JSON (alternative or complement to prompt). Either prompt or filters must be provided.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-100, default 25)

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Search execution mode. "auto" classifies the query. Use "lookup" for direct matches, "simple" for firmographic queries, and "complex" for multi-step queries.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: "network" searches your connections first, "global" searches everyone, "specific_list" restricts to caller-provided identifiers (requires specific_list_data).

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: Pagination cursor (encoded string from a previous response)

include_counts.label: Include Counts
include_counts.description: Inline count scopes to compute on the first page only. Ignored when cursor is provided and adds latency.

specific_list_data.label: Specific List Data
specific_list_data.description: Required when scope="specific_list". Caller-supplied candidate set (1..50,000 entries). Each entry is a bare LinkedIn identifier or { id, score? }.

search_people.beforeRequest: if (!request.body.prompt && !request.body.filters) throw new Error('Either prompt or filters must be provided.'); return request;

sort_people.label: Sort People
sort_people.description: Rank a list of LinkedIn profile URLs by how well-connected you are to them. Returns each person sorted by connection strength (highest first), with score (0-100) and score_label.

people.label: People
people.description: Array of LinkedIn person profile URLs (e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe). At least one is required. A JSON array.

sort_people.beforeRequest: const people = request.body.people; if (!Array.isArray(people) || people.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one person URL is required.'); request.body.people = people.map(String); return request;

join_team.label: Join Team
join_team.description: Join a team using an invite link. Provide the invite link code (the part after /join/ in the URL).

team_invite_link.label: Team Invite Link
team_invite_link.description: The invite link code shared by a team admin (e.g. the part after /join/ in the invite URL)

leave_team.label: Leave Team
leave_team.description: Leave a team you are a member of. If you are the last member of a non-paid team, the team is deleted. Admins of paid teams cannot leave — use Cancel Plan instead.

team_id.label: Team ID
team_id.description: ID of the team to leave

list_teams.label: List Teams
list_teams.description: Get all teams you are a member of. Each team includes id, name, logo, invite_link, and an is_admin flag indicating your admin status.

upsert_team.label: Create or Update Team
upsert_team.description: Create or update a team. The team ID is derived from the team name; repeated calls with the same name update the same team (requires admin permissions on update).

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: URL to the team logo image

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Get profile information for the authenticated user — id, email, name, account creation date, sync completion status, and active flag. Useful for verifying auth and checking whether the user's network data is ready.

import_relationships.label: Import Relationships
import_relationships.description: Import manual relationships to expand your network graph — useful for adding people you know but aren't connected to digitally. Provide email addresses or LinkedIn URLs with optional scores (0-10); higher scores indicate stronger relationships. Max 1000 per request.

people.label: People
people.description: Up to 1000 people to import. Each row: identifier (email or LinkedIn URL), optional score (0-10), optional relationship type. Each item is {"identifier": "...", "score": 0-10, "user_relationship_type": "met_in_person", "worked_together", "studied_together", "attended_event" or "introduced_by_someone"}.

min_score.label: Default Score
min_score.description: Default score (0-10) applied to rows without an explicit score.

import_relationships.beforeRequest: const people = request.body.people ?? []; const minScore = request.body.min_score; if (people.length === 0) throw new Error('At least one person is required'); if (people.length > 1000) throw new Error('Maximum 1000 people allowed per request (got ' + people.length + ')'); if (minScore != null && (minScore < 0 || minScore > 10)) throw new Error('Default Score must be between 0 and 10 (got ' + minScore + ')'); const body = { people: people.map((person, index) => { const identifier = (person.identifier ?? '').trim(); if (!identifier) throw new Error('people[' + index + '].identifier is required'); const entry = { identifier }; if (person.score !== undefined && person.score !== null) { if (person.score < 0 || person.score > 10) throw new Error('people[' + index + '].score must be between 0 and 10 (got ' + person.score + ')'); entry.score = person.score; } if (person.user_relationship_type) entry.user_relationship_type = person.user_relationship_type; return entry; }) }; if (minScore != null) body.min_score = minScore; request.body = body; return request;
